surfaces.name: RegenerationHarness
surfaces.source:
surface RegenerationHarness {
    facing operator: OperatorSession

    provides:
        PrepareRegenerationCut(operator, source_commit, backend)
        ComposeSystemView(operator, cut)
        ProposeSliceSelection(operator, cut, project_identity, operator_intent)
        PreviewSliceSelection(operator, cut, project_identity, slice_identity, requested_items)
        ApproveSliceSelection(operator, selection, digest)
        PrepareRegenerationCycle(operator, preparation_identity, selection, scope,
                                 target_stack, execution_profile, cut_digest,
                                 grader_digest, diagram_digest, max_outer_cycles)
        ApproveCyclePreparation(operator, preparation, digest)
        SubmitRegenerationCycle(operator, request_identity, preparation, parent_cycle_identity)
        ObserveBuilderSession(operator, builder_session)

    @guarantee BuilderIsolation
        -- The builder reads a fenced cut, writes only the declared scope, and does not inherit the operator transcript.

    @guarantee ApprovedChoicesOnly
        -- A cycle runs only from an approved preparation, which binds the cut, the selection,
        -- the scope, the target stack, and the approved sealed grader digest.

    @guarantee IndependentMeasurement
        -- The builder cannot author the gate, the grader, the score, or the measurement used to judge its cycle.
}

modules.description: The regeneration cycle in the legacy shape: fence, regenerate, gate, score, scoreboard. The fence and the gate are the harness and feed the build loop. The score and the scoreboard are the instrument (instrument.allium) and never feed the loop.

surfaces.name: RegenerationCycleExecution
surfaces.source:
surface RegenerationCycleExecution {
    provides:
        ApprovedCycleStarted(cycle)
        CleanRoomProved(cycle, cut_digest, fenced_paths, harness_digest)
        BuilderCompleted(cycle, attempt, builder_session_identity, operation_identity,
                         workspace_generation, assisted, subject_digest,
                         generated_paths, tool_calls)
        SliceBuilderCompleted(cycle, slice, position, builder_session_identity, generated_paths)
        GateReturned(cycle, attempt, subject_digest, target_stack, passed, evidence_root)
        GateAttemptRecorded(cycle, attempt)
        ScoreFiled(cycle, observations)
        ScoreboardReported(cycle)
        DerivePipelineResult(cycle)
        PipelineStageDidNotSucceed(cycle, stage, failure_kind, reason)
        EvidenceReportRequested(observation)

    @guarantee ExactStageOrder
        -- ORC alone advances fence, regenerate, gate, score, scoreboard, and result. Adapter
        -- completion cannot reorder or skip a stage.

    @guarantee HarnessAndInstrumentStaySeparate
        -- The fence and the gate feed the build loop. The score and the scoreboard report to a
        -- person and never reach a builder session.

    @guarantee OneFreshBuilderPerSlice
        -- The first regenerate attempt runs one fresh builder per selected slice in plan order;
        -- each sees the clean room and this cycle's candidate so far, and nothing else.

    @guarantee PhysicalFence
        -- The clean room is a single-commit clone in which every fenced path is absent from the
        -- working tree and the object graph, proved before any builder starts.

    @guarantee ExplicitNonSuccess
        -- Refusal, skip, timeout, and error identify their stage and preserve every approved denominator item.
}

rule FenceCleanRoom {
    when: CleanRoomProved(cycle, cut_digest, fenced_paths, harness_digest)
    requires: cycle.status = running
    requires: cycle.stage = fence
    requires: exists HarnessSelfCheck{harness_digest: harness_digest, passed: true}
    requires: approved_sealed_grader_covers(cycle.grader_digest, cycle.approved_items)
    requires: fenced_paths.count > 0
    requires: every_fenced_path_matched_something(cut_digest, fenced_paths)
    ensures: CleanRoom.created(
        cycle: cycle,
        cut_digest: cut_digest,
        fenced_paths: fenced_paths,

rules.name: RegenerateCandidate

rule RegenerateCandidate {
    when: BuilderCompleted(cycle, attempt, builder_session_identity, operation_identity,
                           workspace_generation, assisted, subject_digest,
                           generated_paths, tool_calls)
    requires: cycle.status = running
    requires: cycle.stage = regenerate
    requires: attempt >= 1
    requires: attempt <= 3
    requires: generated_paths.count > 0
    requires: tool_calls > 0
    requires: attempt > 1 implies builder_inputs_are_previous_candidate_and_gate_evidence(cycle, attempt)
    requires: attempt = 1 implies completed_slice_builds(cycle) = selected_slice_count(cycle)
    ensures: PipelineBuilderSession.created(
        cycle: cycle,
        identity: builder_session_identity,
        operation_identity: operation_identity,
        attempt: attempt,
        workspace_generation: workspace_generation,
        assisted: assisted
    )
    ensures: CandidateSubject.created(
        cycle: cycle,
        attempt: attempt,
        digest: subject_digest,
        generated_paths: generated_paths,
        tool_calls: tool_calls
    )
    ensures: cycle.stage = gate
}

modules.description: The instrument: a checklist derived from the spec, a grader written once, calibrated, sealed, and approved by digest, a score with an honest denominator, and a scoreboard that compares cycles on shared items in both directions. It reports to a person and never

surfaces.name: Instrument
surfaces.source:
surface Instrument {
    facing operator: OperatorSession

    provides:
        ChecklistRequested(selection_identity, scenarios)
        GraderCalibrated(grader, carried_passed, uncarried_failed)
        GraderCalibrationFailed(grader, failed_cases)
        ApproveGrader(operator, grader, supplied_digest)
        GraderRequested(selection_identity, checklist)
        ScoreReturned(cycle_identity, grader, checklist, verdicts)
        ScoreboardRequested(cycle_identity, selection_identity)

    @guarantee DerivedChecklist
        -- The denominator is one item per stamped scenario of the approved selection and never
        -- drifts for any reason other than the spec moving.

    @guarantee StableCalibratedGrader
        -- A grader is calibrated against carried and uncarried behavior, sealed by digest, and
        -- used only after an operator approves that exact digest. It changes only for a recorded
        -- reason, never to turn a failing score green.

    @guarantee HonestScore
        -- Zero verdicts mean no score was filed; an unreached item fails and stays counted.

    @guarantee HonestScoreboard
        -- Cycles are compared on shared items, newly passing and newly failing separately,
        -- with new items counted as the untuned holdout. A net is never computed.
}

rule SealCalibratedGrader {
    when: GraderCalibrated(grader, carried_passed, uncarried_failed)
    requires: grader.status = calibrating
    requires: grader_author_read_only_spec_and_protocol(grader)
    requires: carried_passed
    requires: uncarried_failed
    ensures: grader.status = sealed

rule ReauthorUncalibratedGrader {
    when: GraderCalibrationFailed(grader, failed_cases)
    requires: grader.status = calibrating
    requires: grader.attempt < 3
    requires: failed_cases_come_only_from_public_protocol(failed_cases)
    ensures: grader.status = discarded
    ensures: GraderAuthoringRequested(
        scenario_digests: grader.scenario_digests,
        attempt: grader.attempt + 1,
        failed_cases: failed_cases
    )
}

rules.source:

    when: GraderCalibrationFailed(grader, failed_cases)
    requires: grader.status = calibrating
    requires: grader.attempt = 3
    ensures: grader.status = discarded
    ensures: InstrumentUnavailable(scenario_digests: grader.scenario_digests)
}

rules.name: ApproveExactGrader
rules.source:
rule ApproveExactGrader {
    when: ApproveGrader(operator, grader, supplied_digest)
    requires: grader.status = sealed
    requires: supplied_digest = grader.digest
    requires: grader.replaces = null or grader.replacement_reason != null
    requires: grader.replacement_reason = spec_grew implies
              only_adds_items(grader.replaces, grader)
    ensures: grader.status = approved
}

rules.name: ReuseApprovedGrader
FileScore
rules.source:
rule FileScore {
    when: ScoreReturned(cycle_identity, grader, checklist, verdicts)
    requires: grader.status = approved
    requires: verdicts.count > 0
    ensures:
        for item in checklist:
            ScoreVerdict.created(
                cycle_identity: cycle_identity,
                item_identity: item.item_identity,
                grader_digest: grader.digest,
                verdict: verdict_or_fail(verdicts, item),
                reached: item_reached(verdicts, item),
                evidence: evidence_or_unreached(verdicts, item)
            )
    ensures: ScoreFiled(cycle: cycle_identity, observations: verdicts)
}

    requires: not exists previous_measurement(selection_identity, cycle_identity)
    ensures: Scoreboard.created(

        previous_cycle_identity: null,
        pass_rate: pass_rate(cycle_identity),
        denominator: denominator(cycle_identity),
        shared_items: [],
        newly_passing: [],
        newly_failing: [],
        new_items: []
    )
}

    when: ScoreboardRequested(cycle_identity, selection_identity)
    requires: exists previous_measurement(selection_identity, cycle_identity)
    ensures: Scoreboard.created(

        previous_cycle_identity: previous_measurement(selection_identity, cycle_identity),
        pass_rate: pass_rate(cycle_identity),
        denominator: denominator(cycle_identity),
        shared_items: shared_items(selection_identity, cycle_identity),
        newly_passing: newly_passing(selection_identity, cycle_identity),
        newly_failing: newly_failing(selection_identity, cycle_identity),
        new_items: new_items(selection_identity, cycle_identity)
    )
}

modules.description: Observable session-agnostic control-plane behavior. ORC owns task execution events.

surfaces.name: RegenerationControlPlane
surfaces.source:
surface RegenerationControlPlane {
    facing operator_session: OperatorSession

    provides:
        PrepareRegenerationCut(operator_session, request_identity, request_digest, source_commit, backend)
        ProposeSliceSelection(operator_session, cut_identity, operator_intent)
        PreviewSliceSelection(operator_session, cut_identity, slice_identity, requested_items)
        ApproveSliceSelection(operator_session, selection, supplied_digest)
        PrepareRegenerationCycle(operator_session, preparation_identity, selection,
                                 candidate_scope, target_stack, execution_profile,
                                 cut_digest, grader_digest, diagram_digest, max_outer_cycles)
        ApprovePreparedCycle(operator_session, preparation, supplied_digest)
        SubmitRegenerationCycle(operator_session, request_identity, request_digest,
                                preparation, parent_cycle_identity)
        WaitRegenerationTask(operator_session, task)
        QueryCycleProgress(operator_session, cycle_identity)
        ReadCycleMeasurement(operator_session, cycle_identity)
        OpenBuilderSession(operator_session, builder_session)
        InterveneBuilderSession(operator_session, builder_session, intervention_kind)
        PrepareChildCycle(operator_session, parent_task, child_preparation, reason)

    @guarantee DurableTaskObservation
        -- A replacement worker reconstructs a known task outcome from ORC state and never reruns it to answer a wait.

    @guarantee RefusalBeforeExecution
        -- Invalid identities, selections, scopes, and backends are refused before builder work begins.

    @guarantee SessionAgnosticControl
        -- ORC cycle state outlives the Codex, Pi, or other operator session that requested it.

    @guarantee ExploratorySessionOwnership
        -- Skills, dynamic tools, branching, and human steering remain in the operator session.

    @guarantee ImmutableHandoff
        -- Only the approved preparation crosses into ORC; the exploratory transcript never becomes builder input.

    @guarantee FixedContractOwnership
        -- ORC owns bounded prompt execution, constrained tools, retries, termination, grading, and measurement.

    @guarantee ObservableNotAuthoritative
        -- Live notifications and builder-session views aid operators but never advance ORC state.
}

surfaces.name: RuntimeEvidenceMeasurement
surfaces.source:
surface RuntimeEvidenceMeasurement {
    provides:
        RuntimeSignalCaptured(signal)
        IndependentInvariantChecked(cycle_identity, item_identity, invariant_identity,
                                    producer, subject_digest, signals, verdict, evidence_digest)
        IndependentInvariantInputsIncomplete(cycle_identity, item_identity, invariant_identity,
                                             producer, subject_digest, signals, evidence_digest)
        RuntimeEvidenceReportRequested(evaluation)
        IndependentValidationRequested(cycle_identity, capture_policy, evidence_volume)
        BaselineGradeCompleted(cycle_identity, evaluation, trace)

    @guarantee IndependentVerdictAuthority
        -- Candidate telemetry may supply correlated facts but cannot author the
        -- independent invariant verdict used by the cycle measurement.

    @guarantee IncompleteMeansInconclusive
        -- Missing, incomplete, sampled, or dropped required signals record their affected
        -- kind and reason and cannot silently pass or fail.

    @guarantee DurableBeforeProjection
        -- Reports reproduce a persisted evidence digest and never become verdict authority.

    @guarantee IsolatedCycleEvidence
        -- Independent validation writes only to one cycle-owned evidence volume; the
        -- candidate and instrument-OCI-supplied declarative capture policy remain read-only.

    @guarantee ScoreTraceIsBound
        -- A score is complete only when its genuine Playwright trace exists, is complete, and
        -- its digest is bound into the measurement.
}

steps: Given the operator names a full source commit and an execution backend
When the Pi harness prepares the source cut

scenarios.rule: The neutral source cut is pinned and physically fenced
steps: Given the repository holds implementations, measurements, reports, and the instrument
When the fence builds the clean room
Then the spec, the domain sources, and the public application contract remain readable
And prior implementations, recorded measurements, and reports are absent from the room and its history
And the instrument, its calibration fixtures, and the harness that grades are absent from the room
And a fenced path that matches nothing stops the fence instead of passing silently

scenarios.rule: The neutral source cut is pinned and physically fenced
steps: Given a prepared cut contains Gherkin behavior items grouped into slices, components, and containers
When the harness maps each item and reduces those mappings into a system view
Then every behavior item appears exactly once in the reconstructed hierarchy
And decomposing that hierarchy reproduces the same slice mappings
And any missing, duplicate, or conflicting mapping makes the composition invalid

scenarios.rule: Selection is deterministic and approval binds the reviewed identity
steps: Given the same pinned cut, project, slice, and requested item subset
And the selection has not already been approved
When the selection is previewed more than once
Then each preview contains the same ordered item denominator
And each preview has the same selection identity and digest
And its status is awaiting approval

scenarios.rule: Selection is deterministic and approval binds the reviewed identity

scenarios.rule: The builder produces a new candidate from the pinned contract
steps: Given the Pi harness ORC worker is running
When Pi requests the executable regeneration workflow contract
Then the builder result includes the field "builderSessionId"
scenarios.title: ORC exposes builder session identity in its executable contract

scenarios.rule: Independent checks determine whether the cycle passes
steps: Given the builder has produced a candidate
When the gate inspects and runs it
Then the candidate must define app and test services
And the app must define a healthcheck without publishing host ports
And every required compose operation and candidate test command must succeed
scenarios.title: Verification rejects an incomplete runnable application contract

scenarios.rule: Independent checks determine whether the cycle passes
steps: Given the gate, the score, and the measurement have completed
When the final result is derived
Then it does not pass when the gate or any checklist item failed
And every approved item was graded
And failed approved items remain in the denominator
scenarios.title: A final result requires every independent gate to pass

scenarios.rule: Evidence and measurement survive workflow process restarts
steps: Given an observation or cycle measurement has already been recorded
When the exact same identity and content are recorded again
Then the existing durable record is returned
But the same identity with different evidence is refused
scenarios.title: Recording the same evidence twice is idempotent

scenarios.rule: Evidence and measurement survive workflow process restarts
steps: Given a cycle measurement was recorded through its validated command
When the harness restarts against the same event store
Then the complete measurement is reconstructed with the same denominator and verdicts
scenarios.title: A completed measurement is readable after the harness restarts

scenarios.rule: Backend limitations remain explicit
steps: Given a regeneration cycle uses the host backend
When it reaches the independent grade stage
Then the collector reports that independent comparison requires Gondolin
And the cycle cannot pass as a complete independently graded measurement
scenarios.title: Host execution cannot be reported as independently graded

scenarios.rule: ORC owns the complete ordered cycle
steps: Given an approved selection starts a cycle
When ORC advances the cycle
Then its stages are fence, regenerate, gate, score, and scoreboard in that order
And adapter completion cannot reorder or skip an ORC stage
And missing, skipped, timed-out, or inconclusive evidence remains its own outcome
scenarios.title: A regeneration cycle follows the declared stage order

scenarios.rule: ORC owns the complete ordered cycle
steps: Given the Pi harness ORC worker is running
When Pi requests the executable cycle workflow contract
Then ORC exposes these stages in order:
scenarios.title: ORC exposes the declared stage order

scenarios.rule: The fence and the gate feed the build loop; the score never does
steps: Given the harness and the sealed instrument for the approved selection
When the fence stage starts
Then the harness self-check must pass before any clean room is built
And a passing self-check is reused only for an identical harness digest
And a failing self-check stops the cycle before regeneration with the failing check named
scenarios.title: The fence refuses to build a room for an instrument nobody checked

scenarios.rule: The fence and the gate feed the build loop; the score never does
steps: Given the builder reports that the candidate is complete
When the gate stage runs in an independent room
Then the candidate is done only if the gate boots it fresh and proves its suite green
And the gate records the subject digest without changing the candidate
And a failed gate starts a fresh builder session with only the preceding candidate and the gate's evidence
And the cycle fails at the gate after three regenerate attempts
scenarios.title: The gate ratifies done; the builder cannot

scenarios.rule: The fence and the gate feed the build loop; the score never does
steps: Given a candidate passed the gate
When the score stage runs the sealed instrument against the checklist
Then every checklist item receives a verdict
And no score verdict, evidence, or failure reaches any builder session
And a failed score never starts another regeneration within the cycle
scenarios.title: The score reports to a person and never into the loop

scenarios.rule: The fence and the gate feed the build loop; the score never does
steps: Given the approved slice is not selected by the project's affordance contract
When the score stage runs the affordance evaluator
Then it records a passed non-applicable result with zero checks
And the score continues without requiring screens or forms
scenarios.title: A slice without a human affordance contract does not invent a UI

scenarios.rule: Independent rooms and evidence preserve provenance
steps: Given an observation exists for one cycle, item, kind, and producer
When different evidence is recorded with that identity
Then recording is refused as a conflict
And the original observation remains authoritative
scenarios.title: Evidence identity cannot be reused for different content

scenarios.rule: Independent rooms and evidence preserve provenance
steps: Given a validated observation was recorded
When an Allure or other report is emitted
Then the report preserves the observation identity, verdict, reachability, and provenance
And changing or losing the report cannot change the recorded measurement
scenarios.title: Evidence reports are derived projections

scenarios.rule: Non-success outcomes remain explicit and measurable
steps: Given the <stage> stage is refused, skipped, times out, or returns inconclusive evidence
When the cycle reaches a terminal outcome
Then the cycle fails with the stage and reason recorded
And every approved item remains in the measurement denominator
scenarios.title: A non-successful stage cannot disappear from the result

scenarios.rule: The running harness proves its identity by domain behavior, not by name
steps: Given the harness is started with start.sh speaking JSON-RPC over stdio
When a client sends the cycle-contract request
Then the response names the harness "pi-harness"
And it lists the cycle stages fence, regenerate, gate, score, and scoreboard in that order
scenarios.title: The running harness proves its identity by answering its cycle contract

scenarios.rule: The running harness proves its identity by domain behavior, not by name
steps: Given the candidate passed its whole suite
When the gate launches start.sh
Then the identity probe must be answered within thirty seconds of the launch
And the gate reports how much of the budget was unused
And slow work that does not fit belongs in test.sh, which the gate does not time
scenarios.title: The gate boots the harness within a thirty-second budget and reports the margin

scenarios.rule: The first regenerate attempt builds one slice at a time
steps: Given an approved selection of several plan slices
When the regenerate stage runs its first attempt
Then it starts one fresh builder session for each selected slice, in plan order
And each builder is told which slice it carries and reads the whole spec in the clean room
And the gate runs once, on the candidate the last slice builder left
scenarios.title: The first attempt starts one fresh builder per selected slice in plan order

scenarios.rule: The first regenerate attempt builds one slice at a time
steps: Given an earlier slice builder of the same cycle wrote the candidate
When the next slice builder starts
Then it reads the clean room and the candidate as the earlier builder left it
And it receives no earlier builder's transcript, no candidate from an earlier cycle, and no gate or score evidence
scenarios.title: A slice builder receives only the clean room and this cycle's candidate so far

scenarios.rule: The checklist is derived from the spec and its denominator never drifts
steps: Given an approved selection of stamped Gherkin scenarios
When the checklist is derived
Then it holds exactly one item per selected scenario, keyed by its stable item identity and scenario digest
And a scenario without a stamped identity stops the cycle instead of shrinking the checklist
And an empty selection stops the cycle instead of producing a checklist nothing could fail
scenarios.title: The checklist is one item per stamped scenario of the approved selection

scenarios.rule: The grader is a sealed, calibrated instrument, not a per-cycle guess
steps: Given no sealed grader covers a checklist item's scenario digest
When an independent grader author derives a grader from only the selected Gherkin and the public calibration protocol
Then the author cannot read any candidate, builder or gate transcript, prior verdict, or host credential
And ORC calibrates the grader so carried behavior passes and uncarried behavior fails for every item
And an uncalibrated grader is discarded and re-authored from the failing calibration cases, at most three attempts
And only a calibrated grader is sealed under its scenario digests and offered for approval
scenarios.title: A grader is written once from the spec and calibrated before it is sealed

scenarios.rule: The grader is a sealed, calibrated instrument, not a per-cycle guess
steps: Given an approved sealed grader covers every checklist item's scenario digest
When a later cycle reaches the score stage
Then it reuses that grader without authoring a new one
And it re-calibrates the grader against carried and uncarried behavior before scoring
And a changed scenario digest requires a new grader for that item only
scenarios.title: An approved grader is reused until its scenarios change

scenarios.rule: The grader is a sealed, calibrated instrument, not a per-cycle guess
steps: Given an approved sealed grader would be replaced
When the operator reviews the replacement
Then the reason is recorded as instrument behavior changed, wording replaced, or spec grew
And a spec-grew replacement may only add items, never move an existing item
And a grader is never replaced merely to turn a failing score green
And approval binds the exact digest of the replacement grader
scenarios.title: A sealed grader changes only for a recorded reason

scenarios.rule: The score files honest verdicts
steps: Given a candidate passed the gate
When the sealed grader returns no readable verdict for any item
Then the score stage fails
And no measurement is recorded
scenarios.title: Zero verdicts mean the score did not happen

scenarios.rule: The score files honest verdicts
steps: Given a checklist of three items
And the grader reaches only one item
When the score is filed
Then the measurement total remains three
And each unreached item is recorded as failed and not graded
And the measurement is marked incomplete
scenarios.title: An unreached item is recorded as failed and the denominator holds

scenarios.rule: The score files honest verdicts
steps: Given the sealed grader carries behavior, applicable affordance, and applicable runtime-evidence evaluators
When the score stage runs against the candidate's public seam
Then every evaluator reports per checklist item into one measurement
And candidate telemetry can never author a verdict
scenarios.title: Behavior, affordance, and runtime evidence are scored by the same sealed grader

scenarios.rule: The scoreboard compares cycles honestly
steps: Given a recorded measurement and the measurement of the previous cycle for the same selection
When the scoreboard is reported
Then it reports the pass rate of each cycle with its own denominator
And it restates the comparison on the items both cycles share
And it reports items that newly pass and items that newly fail separately, never as a net
And items new to the checklist are counted separately as the untuned holdout
scenarios.title: The scoreboard compares shared items in both directions and never nets them

scenarios.rule: The scoreboard compares cycles honestly
steps: Given no earlier measurement exists for the selection
When the scoreboard is reported
Then it reports the pass rate and denominator only
And it records that no comparison was possible
scenarios.title: The first cycle of a selection has no comparison

scenarios.rule: The Pi harness is a strictly validated Grain service area inside ORC
steps: Given ORC and the Pi harness have loaded their registered Grain service areas
When the shared Grain runtime starts the Pi harness
Then strict validation reconciles every harness command, event, read model, query, processor, schema, and edge
And missing, extra, or mismatched runtime blocks prevent startup
And CI also resolves every required Grain-to-Allium trace link
scenarios.title: Startup refuses a harness topology that differs from its Grain Event Model

scenarios.rule: The Pi harness is a strictly validated Grain service area inside ORC
steps: Given the Pi harness is running inside ORC's tenant-scoped Grain runtime
When an operator changes or reads harness state
Then every state change passes through a registered Grain command and event
And every public read passes through a registered Grain query over a read model
And no public operation appends a bare event or reads the event store directly
scenarios.title: Public harness operations use Grain commands and queries

scenarios.rule: The Pi harness is a strictly validated Grain service area inside ORC
steps: Given an approved cycle is executing through ORC
When ORC records tree and node execution events
Then the harness progress read model projects the current stage and builder-session reference
And reconnecting clients read that projection through a Grain query
And the harness emits no duplicate progress event
scenarios.title: Harness progress is projected from authoritative ORC events

scenarios.rule: Every public operation refuses malformed or conflicting identities
steps: Given an operator describes the behavior to regenerate against a prepared cut
When an exploratory Pi, Codex, or other operator session inspects the cut composition and asks the LLM to propose a slice
Then every proposed slice and item identity is resolved from that cut
And invented, missing, duplicate, or ambiguous identities are refused
And the resolved selection is recorded as awaiting approval
And a durable session may retain its transcript, skills, tool calls, and branches
But that transcript is not part of the approved execution contract
And no generation or regeneration starts until the operator approves its exact digest
scenarios.title: An LLM proposes a reviewable slice but cannot approve it

scenarios.rule: Every public operation refuses malformed or conflicting identities
steps: Given a cut request does not name a full source commit or supported backend
When the operator prepares the source cut
Then the request is refused before a cut task starts
And an existing cut identity is never replaced by different content
scenarios.title: Cut preparation refuses an invalid or colliding identity

scenarios.rule: Every public operation refuses malformed or conflicting identities
steps: Given the requested slice has missing, duplicate, unstamped, or unknown items
When the operator previews the selection
Then no selection contract is recorded
And the refusal identifies the unresolved denominator
scenarios.title: Selection preview refuses an empty or ambiguous denominator

scenarios.rule: Every public operation refuses malformed or conflicting identities
steps: Given an approved selection
When submission names an empty, absolute, escaping, or overlapping candidate scope
Then submission is refused before a builder room opens
scenarios.title: Submission refuses an unsafe candidate scope

scenarios.rule: Workflow tasks have observable terminal outcomes
steps: Given a source-cut, generation, or regeneration task receipt was returned
When the operator waits for its task identity
Then the result is completed or failed with the ORC trace summary
And waiting again returns the same terminal outcome
scenarios.title: Waiting for a known task returns its one terminal outcome

scenarios.rule: Workflow tasks have observable terminal outcomes
steps: Given no task receipt has the supplied identity
When the operator waits for that identity
Then the request is refused without starting new work
scenarios.title: Waiting refuses an unknown task identity

scenarios.rule: Workflow tasks have observable terminal outcomes
steps: Given an ORC task receipt was returned before the worker stopped
When a replacement worker waits for the task identity
Then it reconstructs the task outcome from durable ORC state
And it does not rerun the task to manufacture an answer
scenarios.title: A durable task remains observable after worker restart

scenarios.rule: The reviewed preparation binds every cycle-defining choice
steps: Given an approved slice selection
When an operator session prepares a cycle with scope, target stack, execution profile, pinned inputs, and outer-cycle budget
Then the harness returns a deterministic preparation diagram and digest
And approval accepts only that exact preparation digest
And changing any bound field requires a new preparation
scenarios.title: Approval binds the complete cycle preparation and diagram

scenarios.rule: The reviewed preparation binds every cycle-defining choice
steps: Given a calibrated grader was sealed for a selection's scenario digests
When an operator manually approves its exact grader digest
Then later cycles score with that grader
And a stale or different digest is refused
And a cycle refuses to score with a sealed grader nobody approved
scenarios.title: A sealed grader is used only after manual approval of its exact digest

scenarios.rule: Any operator session can drive the outer lifecycle
steps: Given a Codex, Pi, or other authorized operator session
When it supplies an immutable approved fixed execution contract through the public control plane
Then ORC starts the same regeneration cycle contract
And ORC owns its bounded prompt, tool surface, retries, termination, and result
And disconnecting that session does not stop the internal ORC cycle
scenarios.title: The control plane does not depend on one interactive session implementation

scenarios.rule: Any operator session can drive the outer lifecycle
steps: Given a cycle is running and ORC emits stage notifications
When the observing extension connects or reconnects
Then it displays the current stage and associated builder-session reference
And it queries ORC execution state to recover from missing notifications
And the progress view never becomes workflow authority
scenarios.title: Live progress reconciles with durable ORC execution state

scenarios.rule: Builder sessions are observable without weakening independence
steps: Given ORC opened a separately identified builder session for one build attempt
When an operator session opens that builder-session reference
Then it can inspect committed model turns, tool calls, workspace generation, and progress
But observation cannot change the builder transcript or candidate
And the builder cannot read the operator transcript or independent grader evidence
scenarios.title: An operator observes a builder session read-only

scenarios.rule: Builder sessions are observable without weakening independence
steps: Given a builder session is active or completed
When an operator pauses, steers, or forks its work
Then the action occurs only at a safe boundary or in a distinct fork
And the resulting candidate is marked as assisted
And a completed builder session is never silently mutated
scenarios.title: Intervention is explicit and provenance-recorded

scenarios.rule: Builder sessions are observable without weakening independence
steps: Given a builder session committed model turns and VM tool results
When its host or execution room restarts
Then the session resumes from the workspace generation bound to those committed results
And an uncommitted VM mutation is discarded or replayed from the previous generation
And transcript state is never restored against a mismatched workspace
scenarios.title: A builder transcript is restored with its matching workspace generation

scenarios.rule: Runtime evidence preserves authority and collection quality
steps: Given the sealed grader drives the candidate only through its public seam
When the score stage completes
Then the cycle evidence contains a non-empty Playwright trace archive
And the measurement binds the trace archive digest
And a missing Playwright trace makes the score incomplete
scenarios.title: A score preserves its Playwright trace

scenarios.rule: Runtime evidence preserves authority and collection quality
steps: Given the candidate emits a runtime signal claiming an invariant passed
But no independent validator evaluated the invariant
When the cycle measurement is reduced
Then the candidate signal is retained as evidence
But it cannot produce a passing item observation
scenarios.title: Candidate telemetry cannot author an independent verdict

scenarios.rule: Runtime evidence preserves authority and collection quality
steps: Given the sealed grader carries the generic evaluator for the runtime signals declared by the approved project model
And one required signal is missing, incomplete, sampled, or reported as dropped
When the score stage evaluates the captured evidence for an item
Then it persists an inconclusive invariant evaluation
And the approved item cannot pass the score
And collection status identifies the affected signal kind and reason
And diagnostic profiles remain available but cannot author a verdict
scenarios.title: Missing or dropped required signals are inconclusive

scenarios.rule: Runtime evidence preserves authority and collection quality
steps: Given an accepted domain event and every required projection snapshot
And every signal names the same cycle, operation, event, aggregate, and subject digest
When the independent validator evaluates the named product invariant
Then it may record an evidence-backed passing observation
And the observation identifies every input artifact digest
scenarios.title: A passing invariant uses one correlated candidate subject

scenarios.rule: Runtime evidence preserves authority and collection quality
steps: Given the Pi harness ORC worker is running
When Pi requests the executable regeneration workflow contract
Then the observation includes the field "artifacts"
scenarios.title: ORC exposes artifact provenance in its executable contract

scenarios.rule: Runtime evidence preserves authority and collection quality
steps: Given the independent execution emitted runtime evidence
And the behavior evaluator returned a failure
When the runtime-evidence evaluator scores the same items
Then it records its own pass, fail, or inconclusive observation
And the behavioral failure cannot skip or author the runtime-evidence verdict
And an item passes only when both evaluators pass
scenarios.title: Runtime evidence is scored independently of behavior

scenarios.rule: Runtime evidence preserves authority and collection quality
steps: Given each selected item has a runtime evidence contract in the pinned project model
When the runtime-evidence evaluator scores the selected items
Then one generic evaluator reads their declared paths, record kinds, cardinalities, correlations, and invariants
And adding a project or item does not require evaluator or ORC source changes
And a selected item with no contract receives a failing observation
scenarios.title: Runtime evidence is selected entirely from the pinned project model

scenarios.rule: Runtime evidence preserves authority and collection quality
steps: Given an independent invariant evaluation and its evidence digest were persisted
When an OTel result span and Allure report are emitted
Then both identify the persisted evaluation and evidence digest
And both name the same candidate subject and grader digests
And neither projection can change the recorded verdict
scenarios.title: OTel and Allure project the persisted invariant evaluation

scenarios.rule: Runtime evidence preserves authority and collection quality
steps: Given an isolated Pi observer session has YOLO tool access inside Gondolin
When the observer profiles the VM while exercising the selected scenario
Then its profile artifacts are recorded as operator-invoked evidence
And the profile cannot become an authoritative grade without deterministic validation
scenarios.title: An operator Pi session profiles a Gondolin VM directly

scenarios.rule: Runtime evidence preserves authority and collection quality
steps: Given the sealed harness snapshot supplies a declarative OTel capture policy
When an independent Gondolin validator room opens for one regeneration cycle
Then the candidate and OTel capture policy are mounted read-only
And the candidate subject digest remains unchanged after observation
And a fresh cycle evidence volume is the only writable grading mount
And the validator image supplies OBI and the OTel eBPF profiler with tracefs and BPF FS mounted
And native OTLP traces, metrics, and profiles are cycle-scoped diagnostic evidence
scenarios.title: Each comparison cycle isolates evidence from its pinned OTel capture policy

scenarios.rule: Prompt optimization is independently measured
steps: Given either example set is missing or not a collection
When the operator requests builder-prompt optimization
Then optimization is refused before an instruction candidate is evaluated
scenarios.title: Prompt optimization requires training and validation examples

scenarios.rule: Prompt optimization is independently measured
steps: Given valid training and validation examples
When ORC evaluates an instruction candidate
Then a fresh builder produces a candidate application
And independent verification and a complete candidate-blind black-box grade produce its metric
And the metric does not require an approved sealed grader
And the builder cannot supply or alter that metric
scenarios.title: Every instruction candidate is scored by independent regeneration gates

scenarios.rule: Prompt optimization is independently measured
steps: Given prompt optimization evaluated one or more instruction candidates for one purpose
When optimization completes
Then the result identifies the winning instruction and its independent score
And ORC durably deactivates the prior instruction for that purpose
And subsequent cycles recover the selected instruction after process restart
scenarios.title: Only the winning instruction for each purpose becomes durably active

scenarios.rule: Prompt optimization is independently measured
steps: Given ORC owns a complete model-directed strategy and deterministic runtime task context
When an instruction candidate is evaluated
Then ORC renders the exact candidate strategy beside the runtime task context
And the evaluated prompt digest equals the prompt digest received by the builder
And adapter code neither appends instructions nor constructs production prompt text
scenarios.title: GEPA optimizes the complete strategy sent through one prompt seam

scenarios.rule: Prompt optimization is independently measured
steps: Given regeneration and gate repair use different builder purposes
When ORC measures instruction candidates for each purpose
Then the generation candidate is measured from a fresh approved cut
And the repair candidate is measured from fixed failed-gate inputs
And behavior supplied by one purpose cannot improve the other purpose's score
scenarios.title: Generation and verification repair are independent optimization targets

scenarios.rule: Prompt optimization is independently measured
steps: Given the operator selects an enabled Bedrock reflection model
When GEPA proposes an instruction candidate
Then the optimization binds the Bedrock provider and exact model identity
And the proposal records sanitized model-call and usage evidence
And AWS credentials do not enter prompts, events, transcripts, or repository state
scenarios.title: Bedrock reflection is pinned and provenance recorded

scenarios.rule: Prompt optimization is independently measured
steps: Given a regeneration builder, gate-repair builder, or grader author starts
When its model session is created
Then ORC supplies both the system instruction and task instruction
And ORC binds their digests to the deterministic runtime context and rendered prompt
And TypeScript transports the prompt without constructing or appending production text
scenarios.title: ORC owns every builder and grader-author production prompt

scenarios.rule: Prompt optimization is independently measured
steps: Given a production prompt describes the candidate and execution boundaries
When the model ignores or contradicts one of those boundaries
Then execution rooms still enforce filesystem, network, and credential isolation
And verification still enforces stack, Compose, health, tests, affordances, and evidence
And prompt text cannot weaken an independent gate
scenarios.title: Harness enforcement does not depend on model compliance

scenarios.rule: Prompt optimization is independently measured
steps: Given GEPA uses the pinned Bedrock reflection model
When Bedrock proposes a builder-instruction candidate
Then a fresh fenced Pi/Codex builder executes that instruction
And Bedrock receives no candidate workspace or builder credentials
And the independent grader remains outside both model roles
scenarios.title: Bedrock reflection and candidate execution remain separate roles

scenarios.rule: The Makefile builds and verifies all configured Gondolin runtimes without graders
steps: Given the repository checkout and its harness runtime configurations
And no sealed grader is available
When the operator runs make -C harness bootstrap
Then npm dependencies are installed in .pi/harness
And Docker builds TypeScript, Rust, Java, Rails, cut, instrument, and grader images
And Gondolin builds the corresponding runtime assets under .pi/harness/.state/assets
And every generated runtime asset is verified
And bootstrap records one manifest binding the harness revision, runtime assets, calibration fixtures, and generic conformance machinery
And carried and uncarried harness calibration passes before that manifest is sealed
And no sealed grader or regeneration state is changed
scenarios.title: make bootstrap builds every harness and supported-stack runtime

scenarios.rule: Harness bootstrap does not build or grade the product
steps: Given the operator runs make -C harness bootstrap
When bootstrap completes
Then it has not built or modified the Löyly implementation
And it has not authored, calibrated, sealed, or approved a grader
And it has not submitted a regeneration cycle
scenarios.title: make bootstrap does not run Löyly application or instrument workflows

scenarios.rule: Bootstrap failure is surfaced to the operator
steps: Given Docker or Gondolin cannot build or verify a configured runtime
When the operator runs make -C harness bootstrap
Then make exits unsuccessfully with the failing command visible
And no successful bootstrap is reported
scenarios.title: An invalid runtime build fails the Makefile target

scenarios.rule: A selected project resolves its own VM and target-stack build files by convention
steps: Given the selected project is loyly
When the harness resolves its project runtime files
Then its Gondolin VM config is harness/loyly/gondolin.json
And its TypeScript, Rust, Java, and Rails Dockerfiles are harness/loyly/Dockerfile.<stack>
And each selected target stack uses only its own Dockerfile
scenarios.title: Löyly resolves its Gondolin config and Dockerfile for each supported stack

scenarios.rule: Missing project runtime config fails closed
steps: Given the selected project has no Dockerfile for the requested target stack
When the harness resolves its project runtime files
Then resolution fails before a Gondolin VM starts
And no other project's Dockerfile is substituted
scenarios.title: An unsupported or missing project stack Dockerfile is refused

scenarios.rule: Every request gets exactly one response carrying its id
steps: Given the harness is started with start.sh
When a client sends a request with id 7
Then exactly one response line carries id 7
And it is either ok with a result or not ok with an error
scenarios.title: A request is answered once with its own id

scenarios.rule: Every request gets exactly one response carrying its id
steps: Given the harness is started with start.sh
When a client sends a method the seam does not declare
Then the response is not ok and names the method
And a following cycle-contract request is still answered
scenarios.title: An unknown method is refused without stopping the harness

scenarios.rule: Cycles are submitted and observed through the seam
steps: Given a cycle was submitted with a request id
When the same request id is submitted again
Then the same receipt is returned and no second cycle starts
scenarios.title: Repeating a cycle request returns the original receipt

scenarios.rule: Cycles are submitted and observed through the seam
steps: Given a cycle was submitted
When a client waits on its task
Then the response reports completed or failed exactly once
And a failed outcome names the stage and reason
scenarios.title: Waiting on a submitted cycle returns its one terminal outcome
